visualCharacteristics.purpose: article and insight teaser cards (photo, optional tag, date, title, summary, Read more) linking to detail pages, optionally under a titled photo banner

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image (optional), cell 2 optional short tag text (e.g. Performance), last cell body with date paragraph, heading with link, summary and a Read more link paragraph. With photo-banner or photo-banner-boxed, an optional first row with a single cell holds the banner photo, an h2 title and a View all link

usage: Insights/news/event listings on home, industry, service and office pages; event recaps; chapter tiles of a report (overlay); single sign-up CTA panel (photo-banner-light)
reuseGuidance: Use for any list of linked content teasers with a photo. Use photo-banner when the list has a titled photo strip above it, photo-banner-boxed when the cards sit in a white box overlapping the photo, overlay for photo tiles with the title over the image, photo-banner-light for a single image-plus-text CTA panel. Use cards-service for text or icon tiles without photos and cards-people for personnel.
